verdict.rationale: Phaser ships a 'Phaser Game Agent' (phaser.io/agent) and an MCP server with 40+ tools that let a user describe a game in plain language and have an agent build/modify it, and the agent.mcp page explicitly says 'you describe what you want in plain language and your agent calls the tools for you.' However, this is delivered by integrating with external AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) rather than a fully self-contained built-in assistant living inside the Phaser editor itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the agent's task-delegation quality, and confirmation the assistant works standalone without a third-party MCP client.
